result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide, well-maintained sidewalks with street trees and ornamental lighting in a commercial district. However, the wide multi-lane roadway lacks visible crosswalk markings and pedestrian refuge islands, creating a significant crossing challenge at a signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of visible crosswalk markings at a signalized intersection increases the risk of pedestrian-vehicle conflicts.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a refuge.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility of the crossing area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide roadway with traffic signals but lacks marked crosswalks and visible pedestrian signals. A gas station on the corner introduces multiple vehicle conflict points across the sidewalk area, increasing risk for people walking.
